direction: dataset-native feature sets are primary; a strictly audited harmonised semantic core is secondary; no feature is invented to recover the old manuscript's 44-feature claim

ciciot2023.label_location: not a column; derived from category directory name

n_baiot.label_location: not a column; derived from file location (device + family + filename)
n_baiot.structure: MI_dir_* / H_* / HH_* / HH_jit_* / HpHp_* x windows L5/L3/L1/L0.1/L0.01 x weight/mean/variance/std/magnitude/radius/covariance/pcc
n_baiot.special_case: demonstrate_structure.csv is zero-row and never enters training

primary_native_feature_sets.shared_experimental_controls: same model families, same training budgets, same evaluation rules, same scheduling algorithm; input dimensions may differ; headline comparisons are within-dataset

permanent.rationale: label leakage (label, type); entity identifiers with memorization risk (src_ip, dst_ip); free-text fields that can memorize capture-specific artifacts

port_columns.rule: never raw numeric values; if kept at all, converted to a predefined port class (well_known/registered/dynamic) with the mapping fixed before any split

categorical_native_only.rule: permitted only in the TON-IoT native model; category encoders fitted on the training split only

ton_iot_exclusions.split_only_metadata: IP, device, file, and capture identifiers may be used for group-aware splits, never as model features

semantic_core.role: secondary; harmonised semantic core admitted only per-mapping through the audit gates
audit_gates: units are identical or an explicit conversion is defined
the official field documentation supports the mapping
semantic_core.three_way_core_rule: only mappings passing the gates in all three datasets enter the three-way core
semantic_core.empty_core_policy: if the three-way core is empty or too small to be meaningful, that is reported honestly; no alignment is forced
semantic_core.target_size_policy: the number of core features is an outcome of the audit, not a precondition; no target size is assumed

candidates.ciciot2023: Tot sum (window aggregate, per official field definition)

candidate_examples.gate_note: connection totals vs window statistics must be resolved against official field definitions before any status is assigned
decayed-window statistics must not be passed off as plain flow totals; the time-window gate applies

paper_positioning: the scheduler adapts to heterogeneous detectors over heterogeneous feature spaces; the paper must not claim a universal 44-dimensional representation
freeze_conditions: official field/statistics documents of all three datasets reviewed
TON-IoT type value inventory completed (read-only pass)
each mapping's evidence_source cites the specific official document

data_handling.disk_budget_note: design work reads inventory JSONs and small documents only; no data copies are created
